text.tspan: Reference-data provisioning pipeline — workflow map, November 2026
derived from the vault's own files: nothing downloaded
ClinVar · ENCODE blacklist · GATK bundle · dbSNP · VEP cache
Orchestration line — run_pipeline.sh resolves the requests, then fetches, registers, derives and checks in one Nextflow run.
--dry-run stops after resolution · the preflight skips what the vault already holds · --cleanup removes downloads once verified · --profile sge submits the derivations only · --clean empties work/.
One copy per set of sequences:
the vault is keyed by refgenie's
every alias links straight to it.
Nothing joins the vault unchecked: a resource must fit its genome's
sequence names and lengths, and a download the size and checksum
By address — a genome file you name
Derived assets — cut from the vault
Interchange — a step several lines share
Stop — one source, file or check
Downloads and registration run where you launch;
with --profile sge the derivations are jobs.
